chunks: God will judge between you on the Day of Judgement in what you are at variance.
ai.seo_question: What will God judge between people regarding on the Day of Judgement?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj underscores that while human scholars and leaders may differ in interpreting divine law, ultimate truth is preserved by Allah alone. It serves as a reminder that worldly disputes, whether theological or legal, are temporary and will be conclusively resolved by Divine Justice on the Day of Resurrection, affirming the reliability of the Ahl al-Bayt's guidance as the earthly manifestation of that truth.
